workload.description: Identical integer workload in six languages: (1) 200,000,000 iterations of a 64-bit LCG (x = x*6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407, wrapping) followed by xorshift mixing (y ^= y>>13; y ^= y<<7; y ^= y>>17) accumulated in a wrapping u64; (2) sieve of Eratosthenes over 50,000,000 bytes counting primes < 50,000,000; (3) naive recursive fib(38). Prints three numbers.

B_toolchains.name: mc
B_toolchains.system_linker: no for macOS/Linux (--exe writes the Mach-O / ELF executable and signs it); Windows executables need lld-link
B_toolchains.self_hosting: yes: the compiler is written in mc and reaches a byte-identical fixed point (mc1->mc2.o == mc2->mc3.o); a 2848-line C23 seed (stage0) exists only to bootstrap (docs/bootstrap.md)

B_toolchains.name: go
B_toolchains.system_linker: no for pure Go (measured: go build -x invokes only pkg/tool/darwin_arm64/link, internal linking; cgo programs use external cc)

B_toolchains.name: zig
B_toolchains.system_linker: no (measured: --verbose-link shows the bundled 'zig ld' driving its own Mach-O linker; the macOS SDK path is passed as -syslibroot)
B_toolchains.self_hosting: yes: the self-hosted compiler replaced the C++ bootstrap in 0.11 (2023); LLVM is still used for optimized backends (ReleaseFast here); from knowledge

B_toolchains.name: rust
B_toolchains.system_linker: yes (measured: rustc --print link-args invokes "cc" = Apple clang driver -> ld)
B_toolchains.self_hosting: yes since 2011 (rustc is written in Rust, bootstrapped from a prior stage0 binary); LLVM backend; from knowledge

B_toolchains.name: dotnet
B_toolchains.system_linker: JIT: no (IL, run by the shared runtime); NativeAOT: yes (measured: ILCompiler invokes clang -> ld and links against OpenSSL, brotli, Swift and system frameworks)
B_toolchains.self_hosting: the C# compiler (Roslyn) is written in C#; the runtime (CoreCLR, JIT, GC) is C++; from knowledge

B_toolchains.name: clang
B_toolchains.system_linker: yes (clang drives Apple ld from the same toolchain)
B_toolchains.self_hosting: yes: clang/LLVM are C++ and build themselves; from knowledge

codegen_proxy.note: mc's count includes strlen/puts/putnum/putu64 (140 instructions) which the C version gets from printf; counting method: mc = lines starting with two spaces in --dump-asm; clang = lines starting with whitespace+letter, excluding '.' directives

D_feature_matrix.note: mc column from docs with file:line citations (see RESULTS.md section D); other languages from general knowledge, marked [k].

generics.mc: no in core (language.md:614-616); examples/lang teaches generics from the surface

structs.mc: no struct; #define offsets + accessors (language.md:623-626); examples/api teaches class

floats.mc: none in core; <float> library teaches f32/f64 via type_new/syntax_lit/intrinsic (language.md:75-76,618-621)

strings.mc: literals only, uptr into __cstring, no string type (language.md:50-54)

closures.mc: &fn + callp intrinsic; no function type, no closures (language.md:469-478)

error_handling.mc: none in the language; exit codes (cli.md:426-441)

memory_safety.mc: unchecked: opaque uptr, ld/st intrinsics, no bounds checks (language.md:73,302-311)

gc.mc: none; examples/lang uses refcounting in lib/rt.mc, cycles leak (examples/lang/README.md:217-259)

concurrency.mc: none in core; examples/conc teaches threads/channels/lock/await (examples/conc/README.md:8-11)

optimizer.mc: constant folding only (fold()); no peephole (surface.md:211-212), no inlining (surface.md:1389), no DCE (guide/80-footprint.md:124), no register allocator (objects.md:302-303)
optimizer.csharp: RyuJIT tiered PGO; ILCompiler for AOT

register_allocation.mc: none: fixed depth registers x9..x15 (depths 0..6), spill via x16/x17, MAXDEPTH 64, frame <= 4095 B (objects.md:189-191,285-299)

cross_targets.mc: macos/aarch64, linux/aarch64, linux/x86_64, windows/aarch64, windows/x86_64 (src/core_writers.mc:57-61); riscv64 bare metal (examples/kernel) and AVR (examples/avr) taught from the surface

package_manager.mc: mc pkg sync|add|list|vendor|verify|hash|check, mc update; mc.toml [deps], mc.lock, MVS, registry https://pkg.minicompiler.dev (cli.md:315-343, packages.md)

debugger.mc: none: no DWARF, no -g; planned M30 (plan.md:442)

reproducible_builds.mc: byte-identical fixed point mc2.o == mc3.o, SHA-256 goldens, 8 determinism rules (determinism.md, bootstrap.md:11-40)

compiler_extensibility.mc: Tier 1 directives (#token/#infix/#prefix/#rule/#include<>/#embed/#section/#opcode/emit/reloc); Tier 2 pass/backend/machine/target; Tier 3/4: 6 word registrations + 7 word-free hooks + intrinsic (hooks.md:286-312, surface.md:646-665)

sandbox.mc: mc sandbox run|exec|check, Linux only: namespaces, overlay+pivot_root, Landlock, seccomp with supervisor, rlimits (sandbox.md:1-31)

self_hosting.mc: yes: C seed (2848 lines) compiled once by clang, then mc compiles itself to a fixed point (bootstrap.md:11-56)
self_hosting.csharp: Roslyn in C#, runtime in C++

native_exe_without_system_linker.mc: yes on macOS and Linux (macho-exe, elf-exe); Windows needs lld-link (build.md:198-199,697,1117-1122)
